observations: Photo 0: Stack of used car tyres on the ground; tread pattern visible, some tyres look worn with uneven/dirty tread surfaces.
Photo 1: More close-up of the stacked tyres; multiple tyres bundled together, tread blocks and sipes visible; sidewalls show age/wear marks.
Photo 2: Four tyres laid side-by-side; winter-style tread pattern (dense grooves/sipes) visible; one tyre has a more faded/dirty tread surface than the others.
not_shown: Tyre size/measurements (e.g., width/aspect/rim diameter) and load/speed rating
Brand and exact model name (not readable from the photos)
Whether tyres are for the same set (same size, same brand/model, same wear level)
Depth of tread remaining (measured in mm) and whether any tyres have cuts/bulges/repairs
Condition of sidewalls (cracks, dry rot) and whether any tyre is leaking
Whether they come with rims or are tyre-only
